evidence.observedResult: Both variants reported DRIFT for source revision db0f7c92984a, 132838 tracked text lines, and 63 active days.
evidence.limitations: Statistics files remain unchanged; any render requires a separate post-feature trigger and authority.

evidence.command: Q06; Q07 and Q09 against a missing CL-12-05 fixture; Q09 against an invalid reciprocal gap fixture.
evidence.expectedResult: The empty, missing-row, and broken-gap temporary fixtures are rejected; canonical Q07 and Q09 pass.
evidence.observedResult: All three negative cases were rejected and the canonical CL-12-05 red/green slice passed Q07 and Q09.
evidence.limitations: Fixtures were written only under /tmp and deleted after the checks.

evidence.command: Q18, Q19 and Q20 from the accepted quickstart.
evidence.expectedResult: No bilingual/A11Y warnings, current Documentation Impact evidence, and no offline Markdown link error.
evidence.observedResult: Q18 passed all four Markdown files without warnings; Q19 passed one current UpdateRequired entry; Q20 checked 1,442 links with zero errors.
evidence.limitations: Heuristics complement but do not replace the recorded complete editorial review.

evidence.command: git diff --check; podman-compose config; uvx pre-commit run --all-files; local hook commands; scoped gitleaks scans.
evidence.expectedResult: Local syntax/configuration checks pass; unavailable external bootstrap is reported without inventing Pass.
evidence.observedResult: git diff --check and podman-compose config passed. uvx could not initialize its sandboxed user cache; a temporary cache then reached the installed pre-commit runner but the remote gitleaks hook bootstrap was skipped because network name resolution was unavailable. All three repository-local hook commands and direct gitleaks scans of the feature specification and dated outputs passed.
evidence.limitations: Owner: Repository Maintainer. Retry the exact uvx pre-commit command when a writable tool/cache location and network or a pre-populated trusted hook cache are available.

evidence.command: rg --files docs/security docs/architecture docs/accessibility sboms audit-logs .specify | sort
evidence.expectedResult: Candidate security, architecture, accessibility, Spec Kit, audit, build, test, and SBOM evidence is inventoried.
evidence.observedResult: Candidate paths were catalogued; file existence alone was not used as proof of control effectiveness.
evidence.limitations: Each positive status would still require a current individual check; this assessment makes no unsupported positive row claim.
